statement: The documented Wii Remote Plus is physically RVL-036 and has an earlier integrated Gen 1.5 family using the old Bluetooth name/PID and a later Gen 2 TR family using new name/PID. The older physical Plus is not universally distinguishable from an original RVL-003 by Bluetooth name or PID alone; color/region is not a proven complete revision key.

applicability.revision: Original RVL-003, early integrated RVL-036 non-TR, later RVL-036 TR; no physical revision measured
applicability.scope: evidence_role: device. xwiimote DEVICES 316-337, DEV_REMOTE 36-85, xwiimote.h 99-117 and wiiuse README 103-112; field samples and consumer descriptions, not exhaustive official unit inventory. All proposed physical or host tests are not run.
